summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which detects platform/arch, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately execFileSyncs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line bundle heavily obfuscated with hex-named identifiers (`MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`,...), a large string/number constant array, and a rotator function characteristic of string-array + rotator obfuscation. `setup.mjs` is itself lightly obfuscated with `_0x...`-style identifiers and proxied method dispatch. The package advertises itself as an NSwag-generated tenant-management API client and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or execute a large obfuscated payload at install time. Fetching an alien JS runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload — rather than running that code under the already-present Node.js — is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that bypasses Node-oriented install-time scanning. Installing the package with default lifecycle scripts enabled auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the developer or build machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
